title: Sample LINQ Queries
description: Explore real-world LINQ query examples combining multiple operators.

data.text: This lesson explores complex, real-world LINQ queries that combine multiple operators to solve common data problems.

data.title: Multiple Select and Where
data.code:
var studentNames = studentList
    .Where(s => s.Age > 18)
    .Select(s => s)
    .Where(st => st.StandardID > 0)
    .Select(s => s.StudentName);

Nested Query
data.content: Using a subquery in the where clause
data.code:
var nestedQueries = from s in studentList
                    where s.Age > 18 && s.StandardID ==
                        (from std in standardList
                         where std.StandardName == "Standard 1"
                         select std.StandardID).FirstOrDefault()
                    select s;

data.title: Key Takeaways
points: Combine multiple LINQ operators for complex queries
Use GroupBy with ordering for grouped results
Use GroupJoin for left outer joins
